title: LC–MS
caption: For compounds that are not volatile enough for GC, such as drugs and proteins, liquid chromatography separates them and electrospray ionisation gently turns each into gaseous ions (often [M+H]⁺) before mass analysis.
alt: A flow: sample in solution → HPLC separates → electrospray ionisation → mass analyser → spectrum.
description: Electrospray: the solution is sprayed through a charged needle and the solvent evaporates, leaving ions such as [M+H]⁺.
